items.source: Get values for given keys from the hash at the bound key. Values are in the order of the requested keys Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List.
items.translation: 从绑定键处的哈希中获取给定keys的值。值的顺序与请求的键的顺序一致。结果中的缺失字段值使用 null 表示，对应于List类或接口。

items.source: Return a random keys from the hash stored at the bound key. If the provided count argument is positive, return a list of distinct keys, capped either at count or the hash size. If count is negative, the behavior changes and the command is allowed to return the same key multiple times. In this case, the number of returned keys is the absolute value of the specified count.
items.translation: 从绑定键存储的哈希中返回随机键。如果提供的 count 参数为正数，则返回一个不同的键列表，数量最多为 count 或哈希大小中的较小值。如果 count 为负数，行为将发生变化，命令允许返回重复的键。在这种情况下，返回的键的数量是指定 count 的绝对值。

items.source: Returns the length of the value associated with hashKey. If the hashKey do not exist, 0 is returned.
items.translation: 返回与hashKey关联的值长度。如果hashKey不存在，则返回0。

items.source: Get and remove the value for given hashFields from the hash at the bound key. Values are in the order of the requested hash fields. Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List.

items.source: Get and optionally expire the value for given hashFields from the hash at the bound key. Values are in the order of the requested hash fields. Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List.
items.translation: 从绑定键处的哈希表中获取给定 hashFields 的值，并可选择性地使这些值过期。值的顺序与请求的哈希字段顺序一致。结果中的缺失字段值用 null 表示，对应于 java.util 包中的List。

items.translation: 使用Cursor遍历绑定键的哈希表中的条目。

items.source: condition - must not be null. Use RedisHashCommands.HashFieldSetOption.IF_NONE_EXIST (FNX) to only set the fields if none of them already exist, RedisHashCommands.HashFieldSetOption.IF_ALL_EXIST (FXX) to only set the fields if all of them already exist, or RedisHashCommands.HashFieldSetOption.UPSERT to set the fields unconditionally.
items.translation: condition - 不能为 null。使用 RedisHashCommands.HashFieldSetOption.IF_NONE_EXIST (FNX) 仅在字段均不存在时才设置这些字段， 使用 RedisHashCommands.HashFieldSetOption.IF_ALL_EXIST (FXX) 仅在所有字段均已存在时才设置这些字段， 或使用 RedisHashCommands.HashFieldSetOption.UPSERT 无条件地设置这些字段。
